meaning:
1) a wild beast, desert-dweller, crier, yelper
1a) a specific wild beast but not certainly identified

renderings.kjv: They that dwell in the wilderness
But wild beasts of the desert
it for them that dwell in the wilderness
The wild beasts of the desert
Therefore the wild beasts of the desert

elsewhere.note: Those who dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him. His enemies shall lick the dust.
But wild animals of the desert will lie there, and their houses will be full of jackals. Ostriches will dwell there, and wild goats will frolic there.
Therefore the wild animals of the desert with the wolves will dwell there. The ostriches will dwell therein; and it will be inhabited no more forever; neither…
